title: Pure Number: Onomat Utopia
summary: "Number" has no Main Deck engine of its own, so this is the page's Onomat Utopia build: the Onomat and ZS engine that makes Rank 4s, Utopia support, Number Xyz Monsters, and generic staples. The Galaxy-Eyes Tachyon package from the tournament list is a second engine, and Masquerade V wants the Umbral Horror cards (see the Gorgonic list), so both stay out. Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light, the newest Number, is the Rank 4 to make first. ZS - Ascended Sage under a Utopia searches Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce, which turns it into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar, and Dragonar calls Number 38 or any other Number on the opponent's turn.

allow.Unbreakable Xyz Barrier: 2026 Counter Trap that Astraltopia searches; it negates and recycles a Utopia from the GY.

main: Utopic Onomatopoeia
Counts as every Onomat family: summons one of each from the hand.
Zubababa Knight
Summoned: searches a Zubaba and copies its Level; detached, searches a Gagaga.
Gagaga Ganbara Knight
Reveals a Gagaga Xyz to summon itself and another Gagaga; detached, searches a Gogogo.
ZS - Ascended Sage
Summons itself on an empty field; as Utopia material, searches Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce.
Onomatokage
Counts as every Onomat family and summons itself next to one; recycles Xyz Monsters.
Zubababancho Gagagacoat
Summons itself next to a Zubaba or Gagaga and revives a Gogogo or Dododo.
Dodododwarf Gogogoglove
Summons a Zubaba or Gagaga from the hand; comes back from the GY.
Gogogo Goblindbergh
Normal Summoned: summons a Gogogo; detached, searches a Dododo.
Dodododo Warrior
Mills a Dododo to summon itself as a Level 4; detached, searches a Zubaba.
Astraltopia
Summons itself next to an Xyz and searches a Number, Onomat, Zexal or Xyz Spell/Trap.
Gagaga Girl - Cell Phone Subtraction
2026 support. Answers an Extra Deck summon with an instant Xyz Summon; detached, zeroes a monster.
Onomatopaira
Discards to search two Onomat monsters of different families.
Reinforcement of the Army
Limited. Searches ZS - Ascended Sage or an Onomat Warrior.
Hyper Rank-Up-Magic Utopiforce
Ranks a Utopia up into Number 99: Utopia Dragonar.
Shining Hope Road
Revives three monsters straight into a Utopia Xyz.
Numbers Protection
Counter Trap with a Number out; Sets itself again when a Number is destroyed.
Unbreakable Xyz Barrier
Counter Trap with an Xyz out; from the GY, attaches a Utopia.
extra: Number 39: Utopia, Emissary of Light
Newest support. Rank 4 that only another Number can destroy in battle; shields a monster and steals what it destroys.
Number 39: Utopia
Rank 4 Utopia for Utopiforce and Utopia the Lightning.
Number 39: Utopia Rising
Rank 4: revives a Number from the GY with its materials.
ZS - Utopic Sage
Rank 4: summons a ZS from the Deck and protects your Utopias.
Eclipse Twins
Generic Rank 4 on top of another; from the GY, revives two Rank 4s as one.
Number 41: Bagooska the Terribly Tired Tapir
Rank 4 Number that puts their monsters in Defense Position and negates them.
Number S39: Utopia the Lightning
Rank 5 on top of a Utopia: 5000 ATK with no response in battle.
Number 99: Utopia Dragonar
Rank 12 from Utopiforce: calls any Number 1-100 from the Extra Deck on either turn.
Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Dragonar's usual call: negates a Spell and absorbs it.
Number F0: Utopic Future
Two same-Rank non-Number Xyz: the base for Utopic Draco Future.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future
Negates a monster effect and steals the monster; can't be destroyed.
Number F0: Utopic Future Zexal
Two same-Rank Xyz: draws every attack and target, and steals a monster on their turn.
S:P Little Knight
Generic Link-2 the page compares: banishes a threat until the End Phase.
